## Purpose
Introduce a non-normative, provenance-aware operational index for T81 research continuity.

## Changes
- `docs/ai-context/CURRENT_STATE.json`: dated observed main SHA, bounded research findings, workstreams and explicit non-authorization.
- `docs/ai-context/CURRENT_STATE.schema.json`: structural schema.
- `scripts/validate_current_state.py`: Python standard-library structural validator (no external dependencies).
- `docs/ai-context/START_HERE.md`: operational entry point.

## Boundaries
No accepted RFCs, historical evidence, production code, CI protections or experimental authorization changed. Observed GitHub data is dated 2026-10-31. Validator checks structure, **not** independent provenance or live freshness.

## Review checklist
- [ ] Run `python3 scripts/validate_current_state.py`
- [ ] Check schema consistency and malformed-input rejection
- [ ] Verify the observed head and PR snapshots against live GitHub
- [ ] Confirm no new authority is inferred from this index

Draft only; no merge requested.
